headline: Anthropic mathematician claims AI-assisted Riemann hypothesis proof
summary: An Anthropic mathematician, Levent Alpöge, says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, a problem unsolved for 167 years. Verification is pending, and a competing human-made solution has also emerged.

claims.statement: An Anthropic mathematician claims to have proved the Riemann hypothesis with help from Claude.

sources.quote: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved 167-year-old math problem with Claude
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis

claims.statement: The claimed proof has not yet been verified.
